subject: Atelier workshop — arrival windows, local liaisons, and AV plan
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir.k@astralsys.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Reynolds <ava.r@astralsys.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atelier workshop — confirming timing windows and local support

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the proposal deck — Astral is excited to host the Atelier workshop the week of Nov 9. A couple of operational asks from our side as we lock logistics: 

- We have executives flying in from the east coast and APAC; can you propose arrival windows that align with a 9:00 AM PT start on the 10th while giving 2 small rehearsal slots?
- We need a local liaison on site for badge pickup and building access (someone who can meet the attendees at the main lobby). Can Redwood provide a liaison or should we arrange with our facilities team?
- AV: we run a short pre-flight for the main keynote — can we get your AV checklist and any special AV requirements (mics, laptop adapters, streaming endpoint)?
- One preference: a quiet executive dinner the evening of Nov 9 for 4 Redwood + 6 Astral execs. Is this something you can organize or do you prefer we handle?

Also copying Procurement (Tom Ellis) on logistics around SOW timing and any travel expense estimates.

Appreciate a quick note with the windows and who will act as the on-site point.

Best,
Samir
Samir Khatri
Head of Partnerships, Astral Systems
Office: +1 415 555 0192

--
Attachment stubs: venue_requirements.pdf (customer-provided)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.k@astralsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Atelier workshop — confirming timing windows and local support

Hi Samir — great to hear, and thanks for the ask list. High level plan below; I put a detailed ops checklist in the attachments.

Proposed arrival windows (to support a 9:00 AM PT start on Tue, Nov 10):
- Option A (preferred): East coast execs arrive evening Mon Nov 9 (land by 7:00 PM PT) — allows 1.5 hr executive rehearsal 7:30–9:00 PM and full night rest.
- Option B: East coast morning Mon Nov 9 arrivals (arrive by 9:00 AM PT) — gives us more daylight rehearsal time but risks airport delays.
- APAC execs: suggest red-eye arriving morning Nov 10; we will schedule a quiet green room for 2–3 hrs post-arrival.

Local liaison: Redwood can provide a local liaison (Monica Patel) to meet in the main lobby for badge pickup and escort — Monica will handle vendor check-in and coordinate badge forms (see attached badge_form_Astral.pdf). Please confirm the names of the executive attendees and any requirements for access.

AV: attaching our AV_Runbook_v1.docx and a venue map (venue_map_v2.pdf). Short summary: we need 2 handheld mics, 1 lapel mic, HDMI and USB-C adapters, and a single RTMP endpoint for streaming. Marissa will lead AV ops and run the pre-flight.

Executive dinner: Redwood can host the dinner on the evening of Nov 9. If you prefer Astral to book, we can still join — happy to coordinate menu and dietary needs.

Next steps:
1) Samir — please reply with final attendee roster + any visitor badge policies by Tue Nov 3.
2) Tom — any procurement constraints on travel/per-diem we should pre-flag?
3) Redwood (Marissa/Rishi/Monica) — we’ll confirm shuttle windows and send calendar holds once roster is final.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar holds for the rehearsal and main day after we get the roster.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Program Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0123

--
Attachments: venue_map_v2.pdf (map stub), badge_form_Astral.pdf (badge collection form)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khatri <samir.k@astralsys.com>, Ava Reynolds <ava.r@astralsys.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Atelier workshop — AV runbook + local liaison roles

Thanks Neha — adding some operational specifics so ops & events can action quickly.

Key AV/run order notes (high priority):
- Primary stream endpoint: RTMP -> redwood-stream-01; we will do a 15-minute stream test on Nov 10 at 07:30 PT.
- Rehearsal windows: 19:30–20:30 Nov 9 (exec sound check) and 08:00–08:30 Nov 10 (presenter tech check).
- Buffering: recommend a 15-minute buffer between breakout sessions to avoid overruns.
- On-site tech: 2 AV techs for the full day (bring spare laptops and a wireless hotspot).

Local liaison responsibilities (see attached Local_Liaison_Roles.pdf):
- Meet & greet in main lobby, escort to registration table, collect signed badge forms, escort to green room.
- Handle courier for any last-minute kit deliveries (we'll share vendor contact).

Travel anchors (logistics note):
- Hotel shuttle runs at 06:45 / 07:30 / 08:15 — recommend east coast execs take 07:30 to arrive comfortably for 08:00 tech check.
- If APAC execs land morning Nov 10, reserve a green room until noon and provide a quiet lunch.

Attachments included: AV_Runbook_v1.docx, Local_Liaison_Roles.pdf (stubs).

Marissa Cole
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0233

Neha / Marissa — this all looks good. Quick confirmations: 

- Attendee roster (execs): Rajiv Menon, Claire Sun, Michael Ortega, and myself. I’ll send full names + titles for badges by end of day Nov 3.
- Executive dinner: Astral would like Redwood to host — please propose 3 restaurants and an estimated spend per head. Dietary restrictions: Claire (vegetarian), Rajiv (gluten-free).
- Procurement: Tom — we’ll need a short SOW and a test of SSO access to the virtual workshop mirror. Can Redwood provide an SSO test account and a placeholder SOW for signature?

Also copying procurement for the contract cadence.

Subject: Re: Atelier workshop — confirmed actions & calendar holds

Thanks all — summary & owners to close out this week: 

1) Attendee roster & badges (owner: Samir) — Samir to send final names by EOD Nov 3. Once received Monica will complete badge_form_Astral.pdf and coordinate on-site pickup.
2) AV pre-flight & stream test (owner: Marissa) — run test Nov 10, 07:30 PT. Marissa to confirm tech crew and bring spare adapters.
3) Local liaison (owner: Monica) — Monica will meet attendees at main lobby and manage badge handoff and green room.
4) Executive dinner (owner: Marissa & Neha) — Marissa will send 3 restaurant options and approximate spend per head by Nov 4.
5) SOW & SSO test (owner: Rishi) — Rishi to share a placeholder SOW and a temporary SSO test account; sending DocuSign link for signature once SOW is final.
6) Calendar holds — I will send 4 holds: Nov 9 rehearsal (19:30 PT), Nov 10 tech check (08:00 PT), Nov 10 main day (09:00–17:00 PT), Nov 10 postmortem (17:30 PT).

Action items with timelines are in the shared Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/atelier-AV. I’ve also opened a placeholder DocuSign for the draft SOW: https://docusign.com/Astro/placeholder-sign-12345.

If there are any constraints (procurement, travel caps), flag them now so we can adjust restaurant choice and per-diem.

Neha Kapoor
